unit.why: A short anecdote: the Besht stands at the door of a beit midrash and refuses to enter, then explains why; it is followed by a homiletic explanation.
unit.boundary_note: trailing 'מענין בית' is a heading for the next section

stories.start_quote: המעשה הידוע שהבעש״ט הק׳ הלך פ״א
stories.summary_en: The Besht refused to enter a study house because it was 'full' of Torah and prayer said without heartfelt intention, which could not rise on high.

tags.why: the scene takes place at the door of the beit midrash

quotes: אלו היו מתפללים העולם בכונת הלב כראוי
tags.why: the quality of prayer is the subject

quotes: הוא מלא על כל גדותיו מפה לפה מתורה ותפלה
tags.why: he perceives the unrisen words that fill the house

quotes: ואז הסביר להם הענין כי אין זה
tags.why: the Besht gives a teaching that explains his act

quotes: כל אורייתא דלאו היא בדו״ר לא פרחת לעילא
tags.why: Torah study without intention is discussed

quotes: ויתמהו כל העומדים אתו על המראה הגדול
tags.why: onlookers' puzzlement is resolved by the explanation
a brief anecdote serving mainly as a frame for a teaching on kavvanah
